children: Yields on U.K. ten-year government bonds, or gilts, rise to their highest since 2007 while two-year gilt yields reach their highest since 2023. The moves come as rising oil prices raise inflation concerns and cause investors to ramp up expectations of the Bank of England increasing interest rates in the coming months. Brent crude price climbs 4.5% to $109.3 per barrel. Markets expect the BOE to hold rates on Thursday, but fully price four rate hikes by April 2027, LSEG data show, a notable increase from last week's pricing of two rate rises in this timeframe. Ten-year gilt yields hit a high of 5.418% while two-year gilt yields climb more than 10 basis points to 4.942%, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
